pull_request.title: feat: show parts that fit the customer's equipment
pull_request.body: Adds an equipment selector to the CAT Parts Store. Once a customer selects their Cat 320 excavator, product cards show an explicit factory-fit status and the catalog can hide incompatible parts. This change affects part discovery and conversion, so ship it behind a multivariate feature flag with control and fitment variations. Track equipment-selected, fitment-filter-enabled, compatible-part-added, and incompatible-part-viewed events; use compatible-part-added as the guarded-release conversion signal.
